notes:
- Version numbers and automatic updates: the panel tells you when a new version is out and installs it when you quit Illustrator
- Speed limit, weight, clearance and other variable signs ask for their value, with a live preview
- Your MUTCD 2009 pack is the preferred version of every sign; other versions are listed in the details
- Large size bar above Place; any size can be made a sign's default
- Placing from the panel is one undo step; Ctrl+Z in the panel undoes the document
